name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Pinehollow goes with neither Cody nor Dale.
The angler at Stillwater belongs to the Pike Family.
Wade, Catfish, and Cedarmere belong to different catches.
Pike goes with at least one of Royce, Wade, or Stillwater.
Bluegill goes with at least one of Dale or Pinehollow.
The angler at Grayreach belongs to the Pike Family.
The angler who landed the Carp does not belong to the East Watershed.
